title: Read elevation gain from HealthKit via HKWorkoutRouteQuery
description:
HK has no pre-computed elevation quantity type. The only way to get total elevation gain from a HealthKit workout is:
1. Query for HKWorkoutRoute samples associated with the workout using HKAnchoredObjectQuery or HKSampleQuery with predicateForObjects(from: workout)
2. For each route, use HKWorkoutRouteQuery to get the CLLocation series
3. Sum positive altitude deltas across all route segments

This is async and requires additional HealthKit auth for HKSeriesType.workoutRoute(). Add 'workoutRoute' to the read set in HealthKitAdapter.authenticate() and implement a separate async helper that enriches a NormalizedWorkout with elevationGain after the main fetch.

Note: Most HealthKit cycling workouts from Apple Watch or Garmin/Wahoo sync will not have route data unless GPS was active. Treat as best-effort optional enrichment.

title: Investigate Hammerhead Karoo API for direct workout sync
description:
Determine whether Relay can fetch Hammerhead Karoo workouts directly via a cloud API, or whether Strava is the only supported path.

Findings so far:
- Hammerhead has a Developer Platform: https://www.hammerhead.io/pages/developer-platform
- They list Strava as an official integration partner — workouts likely flow Karoo → Strava
- They have a Karoo Extensions SDK (on-device Android app SDK): https://github.com/hammerheadnav/karoo-ext — this is for building widgets/apps that run ON the device, not a cloud API
- Partnership/integration contact: hammerhead.integrations@sram.com

Investigation tasks:
1. Check if Hammerhead has a cloud REST API with OAuth (like Strava) for pulling athlete activity data. The developer platform page doesn't clearly show one.
2. If no direct API exists, confirm that the Strava integration path (Karoo auto-uploads to Strava → Relay fetches from Strava) already covers Hammerhead workouts.
3. If a direct API exists, design a HammerheadAdapter following the same ConnectionAdapter protocol.
4. If no API exists and Strava is sufficient, close as 'won't implement' and document the Strava path as the solution.

Likely outcome: Hammerhead workouts are covered by the Strava adapter already, since Karoo natively syncs to Strava. The karoo-ext SDK is not relevant for Relay (it builds on-device Karoo apps, not iOS apps).
